idea: Practice management templates and tools for small studios
pain: No systems for fees, resourcing or cash flow
v1: A template pack: fee calculator, resourcing model, cash flow
channel: Her architecture network plus professional bodies
verdict: Real leverage and genuine need, but the arithmetic at this price point is hopeless.

why.distribution: Reachable directly and through professional bodies, though converting to paid is another matter.
why.demand: The need is widely acknowledged; whether they pay is the open question.
why.fmf: Uniquely well placed - an architect who genuinely understands financial modelling.
why.revenue_structure: One-off purchases, or a low subscription with heavy churn.
why.defensibility: Templates are shared and copied freely within the profession.
why.ceiling: £450 x 440 practices = £198k, an impossible volume in a small, poor profession.

ceiling_arithmetic: £450 x 440 practices = £198k. There are only a few thousand small UK practices and they share templates for free. Realistic: 100-200 sales = £45-90k in a good year one, more likely £15-25k. Structurally capped.
carries: Best leverage in the architecture cluster and genuine authority to build it.
kills: Volume arithmetic. The addressable population is too small and too poor at any price she could charge.
test: Pre-sell the pack at £450 to ten practices before building it.
test_fail: They ask if she will just send them the spreadsheet.
